mapper.select: SELECT notification_id, user_id, type, title, content, target_id, is_read, created_at FROM public.notification WHERE user_id = #{userId} ORDER BY created_at DESC LIMIT #{limit} OFFSET #{offset}
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM public.notification WHERE user_id = #{userId} AND is_read = FALSE
SELECT notification_id, user_id, type, title, content, target_id, is_read, created_at FROM public.notification WHERE notification_id = #{notificationId}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO public.notification ( user_id, type, title, content, target_id, is_read, created_at ) VALUES ( #{userId}, #{type}, #{title}, #{content}, #{targetId}, COALESCE(#{isRead}, FALSE), COALESCE(#{createdAt}, NOW()) )
mapper.update: UPDATE public.notification SET is_read = TRUE WHERE user_id = #{userId} AND is_read = FALSE
mapper.delete: DELETE FROM public.notification WHERE is_read = TRUE AND created_at < NOW() - (#{days} || ' days')::interval
mapper.select: SELECT EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM public.notification WHERE user_id = #{userId} AND type = 'EXPIRE_WARN' AND (created_at AT TIME ZONE 'Asia/Seoul')::date = (CURRENT_TIMESTAMP AT TIME ZONE 'Asia/Seoul')::date )

SELECT ui.user_id, ui.ingredient_id, ui.name AS ingredient_name, ui.expire_date, (ui.expire_date - (CURRENT_TIMESTAMP AT TIME ZONE 'Asia/Seoul')::date) AS d_day, p.is_expire_warn_enabled FROM public.user_ingredient ui JOIN public.profiles p ON p.id = ui.user_id WHERE ui.status = 'STORED' AND (ui.expire_date - (CURRENT_TIMESTAMP AT TIME ZONE 'Asia/Seoul')::date) BETWEEN 0 AND 3 ORDER BY ui.user_id, d_day ASC, ui.ingredient_id ASC
